svg.data-strokes-by: Claude (Opus 5.5), placing each median by eye as straight segments, 2026-10-30; on 2026-10-31 a script of Claude's smoothed each into one or a few cubic curves on the middle of its ink and fitted its widths and ends to the ink; Ben checked the readings of its marks on 2026-10-31; on 2026-10-31 a script of Claude's moved the file to profile 4: flat ends became cuts square to the median, and the letters' round ends became cuts whose angles and places it fitted to the ink near each end
